name: lumi-mobile
description: LUMI native shell (Capacitor) — bundles the web app for instant load, pulls data + auth from lumi24.pl, adds native push.

scripts.build: npm run sync-web && npm run place-firebase && npx cap sync
scripts.add:ios: npx cap add ios && npm run place-firebase
scripts.add:android: npx cap add android && npm run place-firebase && node scripts/patch-gradle.js
